sources.title: Smooth morphisms
sources.verified_scope: Smoothness is stable under base change and composition; smooth at a point is a local source condition.

sources.title: Smooth morphisms are universally open
sources.verified_scope: A smooth morphism is universally open; used with merged C007's proper-plus-open image certificate.

sources.title: Proper morphisms / base change
sources.verified_scope: Properness survives base change and proper image is closed; used only as an image-closure guard.

sources.title: A note on deformations of regular embeddings
sources.verified_scope: Primary deformation-theory control for tangent/obstruction structure of regular embeddings; not used to assert a universal H^1(N)=0 relative-smoothness theorem without checking the relative ambient lifting interface.

sources.title: Variational Hodge conjecture for complete intersections on hypersurfaces in projective space
sources.verified_scope: Positive special-family control: complete-intersection cycles admit a flag-Hilbert route and the relevant Hodge locus is smooth/contained in the complete-intersection locus. No transfer to arbitrary rational Hodge classes.

sources.title: Deformation of pairs and semiregularity
sources.verified_scope: Positive source-specific control for divisor-map deformations under semiregularity when the cycle class remains Hodge. No arbitrary-cycle transfer.

sources.title: Obstructions to deforming space curves lying on a del Pezzo surface
sources.verified_scope: Hostile calibration that Hilbert/flag deformation spaces can be obstructed and nonreduced; supports refusing generic smoothness assumptions.

technical_boundaries: No PDF technical surface was used; primary arXiv HTML/abstract pages and Stacks HTML were inspected.
No source is used to prove arbitrary rational-Hodge witness existence.
No source licenses replacing relative Hilbert smoothness over the deformation base by fixed-fibre Hilbert smoothness or a bare normal-sheaf vanishing without checking the relative lifting theorem.
negative_history: C006 ramification: full image does not imply selected-point differential surjectivity.
C007 cusp: selected-point tangent surjectivity at a singular source does not imply image coverage.
C001 signed-Q cancellation: total-class Hodge tangency does not imply componentwise persistence.
C008 chronology failure: exact-class proper Hilbert source remains open draft/shadow guidance, not canonical authority.
